Vivid
Café & Lounge

Local marketing, made to be seen off-screen too.

Marketing & Customer Engagement Assistant · Oct 2023 – Mar 2025

The Context

Get people to notice.

Give them a reason to visit.

Keep them engaged.

Vivid was a newly opened café and lounge in Hawthorn that needed to build local awareness, encourage first-time trial and establish a reputation from nothing. Local market research pointed to two relevant audiences nearby, working customers and young families, and the opportunity was a low-risk offer that gave them a reason to walk in the door.

The $30 Weekend Lunch Campaign

$30

All you can eat

An affordable introduction to Vivid’s made-to-order Thai menu, built to turn a first, low-risk visit into a reason to come back.

The offer → The creative → In-venue & local promotion

weekend lunch campaign creative

From the café
to the local conversation.

A physical touchpoint that led to a digital action: scan the QR on the table, leave a review, and the visit earned something back. It connected the in-venue experience to a public, ongoing reputation, not just a single social post.
